blocks.orig: Upendo Beach is located in Michamvi, on the east coast of Zanzibar, on one of the most beautiful secluded beaches on the island. The boutique hotel comprises two adult-only villas for 2 persons each and one 6-bedroom family villa with 3 suites that can be rented separately. The smaller villas boast their own rooftop pool and large sea viewing deck, as well as a private stretch of beach. The interior design is light and beautiful, with a hanging chair, multiple large sofas and daybeds for the ultimate romantic getaway. The villa is equally beautiful, with a large pool, sofas spread around the house and terraces, and a wooden balcony with a sea view stretched along the length of the house. Both villas come with a private butler to cater to all your needs, and a restaurant that looks out over the famous Rock Restaurant serves a varied menu of delicious dishes all day long.
blocks.html: Upendo Beach sits on one of the loveliest secluded beaches of Zanzibar, in Michamvi on the east coast. The boutique hotel is made up of two villas for adults only, each sleeping 2 persons, and a family villa with 6 bedrooms and 3 suites, which you can also book individually. Each of the smaller villas has a rooftop pool, a big deck for gazing at the sea and its own private piece of beach. Their interiors are bright and pretty, with daybeds, a hanging chair and several big sofas, perfect for a romantic getaway. The family villa is no less lovely: it has a large pool, sofas dotted around the house and terraces, and a wooden balcony with sea views that stretches along the whole house. A private butler is on hand in both villas to see to everything you need, and all day long the restaurant, which looks out on the well-known Rock Restaurant, offers a varied choice of delicious dishes.
